description: Reverse the most-recent write-off on a time report, restoring the written-off hours to the billable pool. The billing month must still be open. Requires Finance role or above.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

time_report_id.description: ID of the time report whose most-recent write-off should be reversed (required).

name: undo_write_off
